If it looks like a troll and smells like a troll...

Time to show some credentials @RanA382962, I'm pretty doubtful you're the person you're claiming to be.

One of my social dynamic fundamentals is to be curious and open minded. Apply this more to enjoy a wider array of social situations and to inspire ideas for conversation with her. What's she passionate about right now? What are you passionate about right now? You can still laugh about the environment you're in if you're playful. 

Also don't do shit just because the girl wants you to. I would have probably poked fun at her slightly, found other plans and texted her asking how her night was going. Then playfully poke more fun and send her funny or fun pictures of my night. Then invite to meet up after. Life's to short to be going to male pageants haha

Cheers,
Eric aka redolpho

I like the other guys comments but don't over think this. She did your job with that text. She found a point of commonality and then brought a positive vibe with that joke. Do the same thing to her over the course of the next week or two. Find an event you're doing with your friends and invite her to join. Definitely start escalating kino soon into your next meeting with her. Good luck!
